propositions: The lifespan's shutdown drain waits only for the webhook queue to empty via queue.join(), but reconciler reviews run inline in reconcile_once outside the queue, so they are cancelled within ~10s regardless of their actual duration.
When the queue is empty, queue.join() returns immediately and reconcile_loop is cancelled by shutdown_cancel_seconds() before in-flight reconciler reviews complete, losing self-healing retry work.

The drain must wait on in-flight reconciler reviews bounded by the existing shutdown_drain_seconds() budget, not allow indefinite extension by gating on reconcile.request_stop() to prevent new reviews from starting during shutdown.

Both the webhook queue drain and reconciler review drain must share the same shutdown_drain_seconds() budget to respect the stop_grace_period contract (1320s) against the combined floor of queue timeout plus store-lock budget.
